name: Multi Value Field
description: Provides a single field type that stores several related sub-values (a configurable set of columns) together in one field, with matching widget and formatter and a Feeds target.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Multivaluefield 
 Multivaluefield (Multiple values field) is a drupal field plugin, allow to add multiple values on one field.

 Drupal 9 ready.

Compatible with feeds.

 Back to top 

 Examples 
 Add / Create node programmatically with a "Multivaluefield" field 
 Example 1. 
 \Drupal\node\Entity\Node::create(array(

 'type' => 'page',

 'title' => 'Mvf testing page',

 'status' => 1,

 'field_mvf' => [

 'index' => 'Test index 1',

 '0' => "Fields Value 1",

 '1' => "Fields Value 2",

 ],

))->save();

 

 Example 2. 
 (With $nid = Previously created node ID)

 $entity = \Drupal\node\Entity\Node::load($nid);

$values = [

 'index' => 'Test index 2',

 '0' => "Fields Value 3",

 '1' => "Fields Value 4",

];

$entity->set('field_mvf', [$values, $values]);

$entity->save();
